title: Apache Kafka vs Google Cloud Pub/Sub: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Apache Kafka vs Google Cloud Pub/Sub: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

Kafka excels with high throughput and durability, but demands significant operational overhead.
Pub/Sub offers superior managed scalability and lower latency for many use cases, with a simpler operational model.
Kafka: Best for high-volume, on-premise or self-managed, strict data ordering needs. High ops cost.
Pub/Sub: Ideal for cloud-native, event-driven systems needing rapid scaling & managed services. Lower ops cost.

Recommendation: For most cloud-native applications prioritizing ease of use and managed scalability, Google Cloud Pub/Sub is the pragmatic choice. Kafka remains powerful for specific, high-control scenarios.
